LanguageData.Rimlink.Diagnostics.Title: Diagnostics
LanguageData.Rimlink.Diagnostics.Privacy: Preview of the exact local ZIP contents. No automatic sending. No addresses, account identifiers, chat, pins, credentials or paths are included. Log text is omitted; only times and levels remain. Unknown mod identifiers are anonymous. The list is limited to 128 mods and the log to 128 entries; the ZIP limit is 64 KiB. Close and reopen to refresh.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Diagnostics.Saved: Diagnostic ZIP saved locally:\n{0}\nNothing has been sent.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Diagnostics.SaveFailed: Could not save the diagnostic ZIP. Check free space and folder permissions.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Diagnostics.Failure.LocalIo: Local file could not be read
LanguageData.Rimlink.Invite.NoPin: No valid trusted certificate is saved for this address. Connect and verify its certificate first, then export an invitation.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Invite.Paste: Paste an invitation received from someone you trust. Nothing is connected or saved until you review and confirm it.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Invite.ExportWarning: Confirm to copy the invitation link to your clipboard. It shares this address and certificate fingerprint. It contains no account credentials.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Invite.TrustWarning: Verify this address and fingerprint with the server owner through a trusted channel. Confirming adds a local bookmark and trusts this certificate. No connection will be made.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Invite.Conflict: A different certificate is already trusted for this address. Import is blocked and the saved pin will not be replaced. Verify the change with the owner; use the normal connection certificate warning to approve a legitimate change.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Invite.Imported: Server bookmarked and certificate trusted. Choose Connect when ready.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Invite.Invalid: Invalid invitation. Expected rimlink://host:port?fp= followed by exactly 64 hexadecimal digits. IPv6 must be in brackets. Default port: 25560. Maximum: 512 characters; no extra parameters, escapes or whitespace.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Invite.SaveFailed: Could not read or save server trust. Check the local Rimlink data folder; no conflicting certificate has been replaced.
